To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

WAP and i- mode user interfaces are significantly less usable than SMS and web based user interfaces, and that voice user interfaces are also less usable, although the differences are not significant.
the usability of the user interfaces in the Telefonica portfolio is very low (in all cases below 40%) with the exception of the web UIs (which are above 60%).

the usability of a service is highly dependent on the UI that is used to provide the service, and that the usability of the WAP UI is significantly lower than that of the other UIs that we have considered.
In summary, our research is concerned with
evaluating the usability of mobile services.
the usability of the UIs that are currently being used for mobile services and with the evaluation of the usability of these UIs.

the development of a usability methodology that can be applied to the evaluation of the user interfaces of mobile services and with its application to a representative sample of Telefonica's mobile services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the usability of a UI is a function of the user interface and the device.
the voice user interface is the most usable UI for mobile services.

the voice user interfaces perform better than the WAP and the i-mode UIs, but worse than the web and the SMS based UIs, and that the SMS and web user interfaces are the best ones in terms of effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the usability of mobile services is a key issue for their successful deployment, and that it can be measured in a reliable way by means of the methodology that we present in this paper.
the user interface is a very important factor in the usability of a service, but it is not the only one, and that the user interface of the service is not the only factor in the usability.
the voice UI is the best performer, followed closely by the web and SMS based UIs, with WAP and i-Mode being the worst performers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the usability of mobile services is a key element in their adoption, and that the usability of the UI is a key component of the overall usability of the service.
the user experience of mobile services can be measured in a systematic way.
usability is an important factor to be considered by operators and service providers when they decide to offer mobile services.
